name: Addiction
description: You have a pathological reliance on a drug, stimulus, or activity. Comes in mental (ego) and physical (morph) forms. Indulge regularly or suffer withdrawal penalties. Higher levels require more frequent indulgence and inflict larger penalties. Withdrawal may cause −10 per level and other effects. Can be overcome with WIL Checks and abstention. Persists across resleeving/forks (mental) or stays with morph (physical).

name: Age
description: Only for flats and splicers. The morph is old and unrejuvenated. Apply −10 to all physical actions.

name: Bad Luck
description: You may not use pools to flip-flop dice rolls. The universe seems to punish you frequently.

name: Black Mark
description: You have a −10 modifier per level to rep net interactions and social skill tests with one faction. May be taken multiple times for different factions.

name: Blocklisted Rep
description: You are blocklisted in a reputation network. Level 1: rep net outside your faction. Level 2: your faction’s main rep net. Cannot have rep higher than 0. Can be taken multiple times for different networks.

name: Combat Paralysis
description: You must pass a WIL Check each action turn during combat or emergencies to act. If you fail, you lose your action.

name: Dominant Limb
description: The morph is one-handed or similarly dominant. −20 modifier to actions using non-dominant limbs.

name: Edited Memories
description: Significant memories have been erased or lost. Evidence or NPCs with the truth may exist. GMs may use this as narrative hooks.

name: Enemy
description: You have a personal enemy who may interfere with you. Work with GM to define details.

name: Enhanced Behavior
description: You are conditioned to exhibit or crave a specific behavior or emotion. −10 per level if restrained. Higher levels require WIL Checks or cause SV 1d6 if blocked. Can be taken multiple times.

name: Exotic Morphology
description: The morph’s structure is highly non-humanoid. −10 per level to Integration Tests. Required for morphs where this is standard. Not applicable to original morph of uplifts/infolifes.

name: Feebleness
description: Apply −5 per level to SOM Checks.

name: Frailty
description: Morph is less resilient. Durability reduced by 5, affecting Wound Threshold and Death Rating.

name: Genetic Defect
description: Only for flats. Has a genetic disorder. Level 1: minor/moderate. Level 2: significant impairment. Apply impairment modifiers as appropriate.

name: Hypersensitivity
description: Only for biomorphs. Morph rejects all non-standard implants. No bioware, cyberware, or nanoware may be added.

name: Identity Crisis
description: You are stuck identifying with your original morph and have trouble adapting to new forms. May suffer −10 to applicable actions. Roleplay this trait accordingly.

name: Indifference
description: You lack social awareness. −5 per level to SAV Checks.

name: Infection Risk
description: Only for biomorphs. −10 per level to resist biological exsurgent infection.

name: Inherent Flaws
description: Only for synthmorphs. On a critical failure, 10% chance to also acquire a wound.

name: Instability
description: Reduce Lucidity by 5 per level. Also reduces Trauma Threshold by 1 and Insanity Rating by 10 per level.

name: Low Pain Tolerance
description: Additional −10 per wound. Also −30 to SOM Checks and other tests involving pain resistance. Morph version only for biomorphs.

name: Memory Artifact
description: Past ego’s memory resurfaces once per session. Make a COG Check or suffer SV 1d6. GM may use as plot device.

name: Mental Disorder
description: You have a disorder from trauma. Choose from disorders listed on page 224. May be taken multiple times.

name: Morphing Disorder
description: −10 per level to Integration and Resleeving Stress Tests.

name: Neural Damage
description: Permanent neurological issue affecting your ego. Examples: Amusica, Color Blindness, Synaesthesia, etc. Choose effects with GM. Apply −10 modifiers as appropriate. May be taken multiple times.

name: No Backup Insurance
description: No backups exist. Reinstantiation depends on circumstance. May result in permadeath or lost MP.

name: Non-Human Biochemistry
description: Only for biomorphs. Level 1: non-human morph. Level 2: non-mammalian. −10 per level to Medicine Tests. Incompatible with some treatments.

name: Obliviousness
description: −10 to Perceive Tests vs surprise, −30 distracted modifier.

name: Obtuseness
description: Apply −5 per level to COG Checks.

name: Planned Obsolescence
description: Morph needs monthly service. Skipping causes pool reduction and then wounds. Four wounds = incapacitation.

name: Poor Coordination
description: −5 per level to REF Checks.

name: Poor Instincts
description: −5 per level to INT Checks.

name: Proprietary Tech
description: Only for synthmorphs. Hardware: Robotics −20. Fixer nanos don’t work. Requires proprietary support.

name: Psi Vulnerability
description: Psi sleights are more effective against you. Apply −10 per level when resisting psi. Morph version only applies to morphs with biological brains.

name: Real World Naiveté
description: You lack real-world experience or common sense. Once per session, the GM may intentionally mislead your interpretation of events or interactions. Roleplay accordingly.

name: Restricted Behavior
description: You are conditioned to avoid a specific behavior or emotion. −10 per level when exposed. Level 1: discouraged. Level 2: blocked, requires WIL Check to override. Level 3: incapable, causes SV 1d6 if forced. Can be taken multiple times.

name: Sensitive
description: Apply −10 per level to INT Checks to resist basilisk hacks. Your brain is vulnerable to exploit via sensory input.

name: Severe Allergy
description: Only for biomorphs. Severe anaphylactic reaction to a specific allergen. −30 modifier while exposed and 10 minutes after. Must make SOM Check or go into shock. Requires medical intervention to survive. Choose allergen with GM.

name: Skill Glitch
description: Unfixable glitch affects one skill (chosen or random). −10 per level to that skill’s use.

name: Timidity
description: Apply −5 per level to WIL Checks. You are easily intimidated or hesitant.

name: Unattractiveness
description: Only for uplifts/synthmorphs (Level 1) or humanoid biomorphs (Level 2). Apply −10 to Persuade and Provoke Tests where appearance matters.

name: VR Vertigo
description: You suffer vertigo and nausea from VR and XP. −30 to all actions while interfacing with VR/XP, −10 in AR. Must pass SOM Check after 1 hour or be incapacitated for 10 minutes.

name: Weak Immune System
description: Only for biomorphs. Apply −10 per level when resisting diseases, drugs, toxins, or chemicals.

name: Zero-G Nausea
description: Only for biomorphs. Suffer −10 modifier in microgravity. Must make SOM Check to avoid 1-hour incapacitation upon initial movement or acclimation in zero-g.
